infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Auto Toon uses the camera so you can take a product or face photo for AI generation — for example, snap a shoe on a table to produce an on-model studio shot, or capture a selfie to create a custom AI fashion model.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Auto Toon needs photo library access so you can pick a product photo (apparel, shoe, accessory, beauty) or face reference image to generate AI fashion editorials, on-model shots, and product videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Auto Toon saves your generated AI photos and videos to your photo library so you can share or use them outside the app.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Auto Toon uses the microphone if you record audio narration for an AI-generated commercial video; access is only requested when you start a recording.
